title: 有馬記念の後に・ファイナルアプローチ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun emerges victorious at the Arima Kinen. As promised, I tell her that she twinkled brighter than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After finally hearing the words she has wanted to hear more than anything, tears of happiness pour down her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the ceremony commemorating Narita Brian's final race approaches, Mayano Top Gun selfishly pleads with her to continue racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having grown into a truly brilliant racer, she ultimately manages to keep Narita Brian from retiring.
